name: @widnyana/iac-check-guard
description: pi extension that blocks IaC write/destructive commands before the Bash tool runs: ansible writes (ansible-playbook/ansible-pull without --check, ad-hoc ansible write modules), terragrunt/tofu/terraform apply-family (apply, destroy, import, init, plan -out/-replace/-destroy, state mutations, stack clean/generate), including mise-wrapped forms. Shares its check script with the Claude Code plugin plugins/iac-check-guard.
